criteria.name: ISO 9001 Certification
criteria.kpiDefinition: Valid, accredited ISO 9001 certificate whose scope covers the licensed waste transport activity in Abu Dhabi. Enter 1 = held and valid on assessment date; 0 = not held/expired/out of scope.
criteria.dataSource: ESP upload; certificate checked against accredited certification body / IAF CertSearch
criteria.evidenceRequired: Valid ISO 9001 certificate incl. scope and accreditation mark

criteria.name: Grievance & Complaint Management
criteria.kpiDefinition: Level achieved: 0 = no documented procedure; 1 = documented procedure AND complaint register maintained; 2 = Level 1 AND ≥90% of complaints closed within the ESP's own documented target time over the last 12 months.
criteria.dataSource: ESP complaint register; EAD site inspection sample
criteria.evidenceRequired: Grievance procedure; complaint register (12 months) with closure dates

criteria.name: Licensed Operational Experience
criteria.kpiDefinition: Years of continuous operation under a valid EAD waste transport permit, counted from first permit issue to assessment date.

criteria.name: Waste-Sector Specialisation
criteria.kpiDefinition: Share of waste-management activity codes in the total activity codes registered on the DED commercial licence = waste-related codes ÷ total codes × 100.

criteria.name: In-Country Value (ICV)
criteria.kpiDefinition: Level: 0 = no valid ICV certificate; 1 = valid ICV certificate; 2 = ICV score ≥ median ICV score of ESPs assessed in the same matrix (median fixed after first assessment cycle).

criteria.name: Customer Satisfaction Rating (Bolisaty)
criteria.kpiDefinition: Average generator/receiving-facility rating (1–5), minimum 20 ratings.
criteria.scoringRule: Proposed max 3 pts when activated (weights to be rebalanced)

criteria.name: Financial Resilience
criteria.kpiDefinition: Current ratio from latest audited financial statements + valid insurance.
criteria.scoringRule: Proposed max 3 pts when activated (weights to be rebalanced)

criteria.name: Vehicle Tracking (GPS) Compliance
criteria.kpiDefinition: Tracking availability = vehicle-days with a functioning, reporting tracking device ÷ total vehicle-days of the licensed fleet × 100, rolling 12 months. If the account was suspended for tracking non-maintenance in the last 12 months, enter 0.

criteria.name: Fleet Availability (Unplanned Downtime)
criteria.kpiDefinition: Fleet availability = 1 − (vehicle-days out of service due to unplanned breakdown ÷ scheduled vehicle-days) × 100, rolling 12 months.
criteria.dataSource: Control room idle data (GPS) + maintenance logs; inspection checklist

criteria.name: Waste Consignment Traceability (e-Manifest)
criteria.kpiDefinition: Share of trips/consignments with a complete e-manifest (generator, waste type, quantity, receiving facility) AND delivered to an EAD-licensed facility permitted for that waste type, rolling 12 months.
criteria.dataSource: Bolisaty / Waste Manifest System; EAD Licensing

criteria.name: Operational Workforce Competence
criteria.kpiDefinition: Share of sampled operational staff (drivers, loaders, supervisors) holding all mandatory role-specific training and competence records valid on the inspection date. Sample: minimum 10 staff, or all staff if fewer than 10.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Training matrix; certificates; induction and refresher records

criteria.name: Operational Capacity & Market Presence
criteria.kpiDefinition: Sector percentile rank of tonnes transported (rolling 12 months) among ESPs assessed in the same matrix. If tonnage is not yet reliable, use licensed fleet size (DEC-2025 register: P25 = 1, P50 = 2, P75 = 4, P90 = 10 vehicles).

criteria.name: Geographic Coverage
criteria.kpiDefinition: Number of Abu Dhabi regions (Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Al Dhafra) in which the ESP performed ≥5% of its trips, rolling 12 months.

criteria.name: Fleet Environmental Standard (Euro 5/6 / alternative fuel)
criteria.kpiDefinition: Share of licensed vehicles meeting Euro 5, Euro 6 or an alternative powertrain (electric, hybrid, gas) = compliant vehicles ÷ total licensed vehicles × 100, at assessment date.
criteria.dataSource: ESP submission per vehicle (manufacturer spec / registration data); cross-check against EAD fleet register (model year #15, fuel type #16)
criteria.evidenceRequired: Per-vehicle emission standard evidence (registration card / manufacturer specification)

criteria.name: Active Operational Scope
criteria.kpiDefinition: Number of EAD-permitted waste management activities (across all valid EAD waste permits of the ESP, incl. transport) in which the ESP recorded actual transactions in Bolisaty during the last 12 months. Activities permitted but not used do not count.
criteria.dataSource: EAD Licensing (permitted activities) + Bolisaty (waste types actually handled)

criteria.name: Illegal Dumping Response
criteria.kpiDefinition: Illegal dumping cases assigned to and closed by the ESP within deadline.
criteria.scoringRule: Proposed max 2 pts when activated (weights to be rebalanced)

criteria.name: ISO 14001 Certification
criteria.kpiDefinition: Valid, accredited ISO 14001 certificate whose scope covers the licensed waste transport activity in Abu Dhabi. Enter 1 = held and valid on assessment date; 0 = not held/expired/out of scope.
criteria.dataSource: ESP upload; certificate checked against accredited certification body / IAF CertSearch
criteria.evidenceRequired: Valid ISO 14001 certificate incl. scope and accreditation mark

criteria.name: ISO 45001 Certification
criteria.kpiDefinition: Valid, accredited ISO 45001 certificate whose scope covers the licensed waste transport activity in Abu Dhabi. Enter 1 = held and valid on assessment date; 0 = not held/expired/out of scope.
criteria.dataSource: ESP upload; certificate checked against accredited certification body / IAF CertSearch
criteria.evidenceRequired: Valid ISO 45001 certificate incl. scope and accreditation mark

criteria.name: Environmental Compliance Index
criteria.kpiDefinition: Severity-weighted violation index, rolling 12 months = (No. of Minor violations × 1) + (No. of Major violations × 3), including illegal dumping cases attributed to the ESP. Critical violations are handled by Gate G1.

criteria.name: Corrective Action Closure
criteria.kpiDefinition: Share of corrective actions raised by EAD inspections that were closed within the EAD deadline, rolling 12 months. If no corrective actions were raised, enter 100.
criteria.dataSource: EAD inspection database – corrective action status

criteria.name: HSE & Road Safety Rate
criteria.kpiDefinition: (Recordable work injuries + vehicle accidents) per 10 licensed vehicles, rolling 12 months = events ÷ fleet size × 10. Fatalities are handled by Gate G1.
criteria.dataSource: EAD SRA module; ESP HSE register

criteria.name: GHG Emissions Monitoring
criteria.kpiDefinition: Level: 0 = none; 1 = annual Scope 1 & 2 inventory using a recognised method (GHG Protocol / ISO 14064-1) based on activity data; 2 = Level 1 AND emission intensity KPI tracked (e.g. kgCO2e per tonne handled); 3 = Level 2 AND third-party verification OR demonstrated year-on-year intensity reduction.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Annual GHG inventory; verification statement where claimed

criteria.name: Digital Fleet Management System
criteria.kpiDefinition: Number of functions demonstrated live (0–5): (1) vehicle register; (2) preventive maintenance scheduling; (3) trip/job dispatch records; (4) driver records incl. licence validity; (5) fuel/km data.

criteria.name: Timely Digital Reporting
criteria.kpiDefinition: Share of e-manifests / waste transactions recorded and closed in Bolisaty within 24 hours of the physical transfer, rolling 12 months.
